raw_segments.text: Such, then, are the objects proposed by our treatise, which is of the nature of Pi-Omicron
Lambda, Yoda Tau, Yoda Kappa, letter 1f74.
And I conceive I shall have spoken on them satisfactorily if they be made as distinctly
clear as the nature of the subject matter will admit, for exactness must not be looked
for in all discussions alike, any more than in all works of handicraft.
